snippet.title: Fate/Grand Order - Epic of Remnant Pseudo-Singularity I PV
snippet.description:
A new chapter begins in Fate/Grand Order! Epic of Remnant Pseudo-Singularity I: Quarantined Territory of Malice, Shinjuku - Shinjuku Phantom Incident is coming soon!

The curtain rises on Pseudo-Singularity I.

The stage: Shinjuku. Fight alongside mysterious new Servants
in a prison district cut off from the outside world. 

For more information, visit fate-go.us/shinjuku
